svg.metadata: {"id": "s053", "name": "陶艺室", "cat": "艺术与劳动", "tags": ["美术", "陶艺", "劳动", "传统工艺"], "desc": "温暖的陶艺工作室：拉坯机上正在成形的陶罐，墙上木架摆满各色釉陶，左侧砖砌窑炉透出火光，陶土袋与工具。", "stand": {"ground_y": 910, "x": [560, 1260]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "window", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "shelves", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 0.45, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "floor", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "kiln", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "kiln_glow", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "wheel", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.55, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "pot_on_wheel", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.75, "loop": "bob", "depth": null}, {"name": "tools", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.9, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "lamps", "enter": "drop", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "plant", "enter": "grow", "delay": 1.1, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#F7E4D3", "wall2": "#EDCDB3", "brickw": "#E6BFA0", "floor1": "#D8CFC4", "floor2": "#C2B7AA", "shelf": "#A9774E", "shelf2": "#875A36", "clay": "#C98458", "clay2": "#A9663F", "clay3": "#E3A57A", "g1": "#5FA8A0", "g2": "#F1E6D2", "g3": "#E2A64A", "g4": "#6E8FCC", "g5": "#D9705A", "g6": "#9BBF86", "kiln": "#C0674A", "kiln2": "#9E513A", "kbrick": "#D78463", "fire": "#FF9A3D", "fire2": "#FFD36E", "wheel": "#5D6A78", "wheel2": "#8796A6", "water": "#9FD3E8", "lamp": "#FFE3A3", "leaf": "#7DB57E", "leaf2": "#A9D69B", "sack": "#E9D9B8", "sack2": "#CDB98F", "win1": "#A9DDF5", "win2": "#EAF7FF"}}
